# Joost Muijsenberg — free puzzle and card games for Android

> Small, classic Android games made by Joost Muijsenberg as a hobby project in his spare time. Every game is free, works fully offline and never asks for an account; progress stays on the device. The games show ads, which can be removed with one optional in-app purchase.

Each game has its own page with screenshots, a description, frequently asked questions, its privacy policy and terms of service. Pages exist in several languages; the language versions are listed per game.

## Games on Google Play (and the App Store)

- [Merge Puzzle: 2048 Number Game](https://jooostt.github.io/mergepuzzle/): Merge puzzle game: slide and merge number tiles to 2048. New daily challenge. Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.joostmuijsenberg.mergepuzzle Also in: [Nederlands](https://jooostt.github.io/nl/mergepuzzle/), [Deutsch](https://jooostt.github.io/de/mergepuzzle/), [Español](https://jooostt.github.io/es/mergepuzzle/), [Français](https://jooostt.github.io/fr/mergepuzzle/), [Português](https://jooostt.github.io/pt/mergepuzzle/), [Italiano](https://jooostt.github.io/it/mergepuzzle/), [Türkçe](https://jooostt.github.io/tr/mergepuzzle/).
